simple.meaning: רִיפַת (Rîyphath) is a Hebrew word meaning “Riphath , a grandson of Japheth and his descendants.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: רִיפַת (H7384) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 10:3, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רִיפַת (H7384) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in רִיפַת (H7384) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: רִיפַת (Rîyphath) / H7384 is traced through Genesis 10:3, 1 Chronicles 1:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
